items.title: Land A Return From Delta Air Lines Stock — Any Which Way It Travels
items.summary: Delta Air Lines stock is currently trading with a very low implied volatility rank, meaning options are cheap compared to the last 12 months.  Delta Air Lines is a major U.S. carrier headquartered in Atlanta, where it operates at the world's busiest airport as its primary hub.

items.title: Swelling jet fuel costs hit American Airlines outlook
items.summary: American Airlines lowered its annual profit outlook Thursday, hitting shares while the carrier pointed to swelling jet fuel costs as a negative counterweight to healthy travel demand.American said it expects $6 billion in additional jet fuel costs in 2026.
